rule.name: SpringHttpClientTimeouts
rule.message: Build this HTTP client with connect and read timeouts, from the injected RestClient.Builder or RestTemplateBuilder (spring.http.client.* properties), with a request factory or connector that sets them, or with connectTimeout and readTimeout on the builder; give a Reactor Netty HttpClient a responseTimeout. A client without timeouts waits forever for a slow server.
